import Std
namespace CapstoneV9NatDev

def orbit (next : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, initial => initial
  | k + 1, initial => orbit next k (next initial)

theorem orbit_add (next : Nat → Nat) (steps tail : Nat) (initial : Nat) :
    orbit next (steps + tail) initial = orbit next tail (orbit next steps initial) := by
  induction steps with
  | zero => simp [orbit]
  | succ steps ih =>
      simpa [Nat.succ_add, orbit] using ih (next initial)

end CapstoneV9NatDev

import Std
namespace CapstoneV9FoldDev



theorem foldl_append (f : Nat → Nat → Nat) (acc : Nat) (xs ys : List Nat) :
    List.foldl f acc (xs ++ ys) = List.foldl f (List.foldl f acc xs) ys := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons head tail ih =>
      simpa [List.foldl] using ih (f acc head)

end CapstoneV9FoldDev
